full_details: There was no morning rehearsal. Mistress Ansell had the kitchen copper on for Monday's oak-gall ink, from her husband's receipt. Your horn was still half full, at twopence when it wants filling. The penny loaf was a finger short, and the board was threepence. Gib sat on the book. Gillis was already gone to his loom in Norton Folgate. At two you played in Titus at the Cross Keys. The Rose billed Siege of London. You did not go. After the play, in the parlour, Burbage said your voice had held. Berowne is long, and Thursday the twentieth is seventeen days off. Heminges will take Nick to a mercer in Cheapside tomorrow and call you when he knows the price. He did not name a sum. Kemp was civil. At home the Candlemas packet was still on the desk.
one_sentence: You stayed for the ink, played in Titus at two, and left the gown's price for tomorrow's call.
title: Monday's ink, and Titus at two
